title: Company Logos
concept: Brisa North, a fictional North Sea wind farm operator: a pale instrument-panel hero with turning turbines over a hairline-divided supplier logo row, then a 16-cell partner grid and a turbine anatomy legend — every mark an Iconify Simple Icons glyph in a shared 64x64 box, monochrome until hover/focus restores its brand colour.
notes: Logos load at runtime from the Iconify API via the installed iconify-icon web component (needs network). Real company logos illustrate the logo system only; the operator and its supplier claims are fictional. Reduced motion stops the rotors, wind streams and beacons.
